extends Node
var p
func _ready() -> void:
	p = get_meta("viento_project")
	set_process(false)
	set_physics_process(false)
	call_deferred("_start")
func _start() -> void:
	var host = p.host.get_ref()
	host.set_process(false)
	first_token = p.subscribe_event("root", _first)
	failed_token = p.subscribe_event("root", _fails)
	p.subscribe_event("root", _never)
	p.subscribe_event("nested", _nested)
	_published("root", p.publish_event("root", 1))
	host.flush_requests()
func _probe(kind: String, label: String, extra: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	var data := {"kind": kind, "label": label, "clock": {"idleFrame": Engine.get_process_frames(), "physicsFrame": Engine.get_physics_frames()}}
	data.merge(extra)
	print("VIENTO_EVENT_POSITION_PROBE:" + JSON.stringify(data))
func _published(label: String, accepted: bool) -> void:
	_probe("published", label, {"accepted": accepted, "sequence": p.host.get_ref().event_bus.sequence})
func _delivered(label: String, sequence: int, subscription_id: int) -> void:
	_probe("delivered", label, {"sequence": sequence, "subscriptionId": subscription_id})
func _finish() -> void:
	p.host.get_ref().finish_project()
var first_token := 0
var failed_token := 0
func _first(_value) -> bool:
	p.write_state("first_ran", true)
	_published("nested", p.publish_event("nested", 2))
	_delivered("first", 1, first_token)
	return true
func _fails(_value) -> bool:
	p.write_state("failed_ran", true)
	_probe("attempted", "failed-recipient", {"sequence": 1, "subscriptionId": failed_token})
	return false
func _never(_value) -> bool:
	_probe("unexpected", "last-recipient")
	return false
func _nested(_value) -> bool:
	_probe("unexpected", "nested-recipient")
	return false
